source: Schooling: men aged 15 to 49 with 10 or more years of schooling, NFHS-6 (2023-24) state and India fact sheets, International Institute for Population Sciences; the 2019-21 figure is printed beside it. 34 states and UTs ranked; Lakshadweep (small sample) is not ranked and Manipur has no NFHS-6 fact sheet.
